title: 第6章 接连突破
slug: 修炼狂潮全本免费-修炼狂潮最新章节列表
content_zh:
在撕裂与清爽同时交加的情况下，楚云凡可以说是欲生欲死，不过他还是咬着牙，继续坚持了下来。
他这是要将肉身境第五重内壮修炼到巅峰，内壮，顾名思义就是内脏的强大，可以想象他的内脏就处于那种剧烈的被撕裂，又被修复，又被撕裂，又被恢复的来回拉锯之中，是多么的痛楚了。
终于，当他再度睁开了眼睛的时候，已经是两个小时之后了！
“终于修炼到内壮的巅峰，我已经完成了内脏的淬炼，真是不敢想象这样的速度会出现在我的身上，要只知道，我一个月前才刚刚突破到内壮，本来还以为还要几个月才能突破到内壮巅峰呢！”楚云凡暗道，此时他的思维清晰，顿时就想到了很多的事情。
他的修行速度如此之快，除了因为《天长地久皇极功》的强大之外，更重要的是，他的身体好像已经经过了相当程度的改造，否则速度就算再快，也不可能在短短几个小时内的修行就超过了他之前六年的修炼。
是那个时候看都看不清楚的那一团光，将他的无数细胞撕裂又重组，又撕裂又重组，在那个时候，他的肉身就被改造过了，只是现在修炼《天长地久皇极功》的时候，体现出来罢了。
还有那一股清流，也不知道是哪儿来的，钥匙没有这一股清流镇痛，他光是因为疼痛都可能停止下来好多次，修行起来根本不可能这么顺利！
“到底是什么进入我的体内呢？”楚云凡不由得有些疑惑了起来，“先不管了，总而言之，这对我来说是一件好事，只要到了肉身境第八重内视，就知道究竟是什么东西了！”
肉身境修行的第八重，就是内视，顾名思义，就是能够看到自己体内的情况，什么血管，内脏，肌肉等等，但是这个看，并不是以目光看，而是将肉身掌控到了一个极致之后，所有的一切都感知的到，在脑海中浮现出身体的诸多细节，从而形成类似看一样的效果。
“既然已经修炼到了内壮巅峰，今天晚上我就再接再厉，直接冲击第六重筋骨齐鸣！”
楚云凡暂时决定先将心中的疑惑放到一边，先突破要紧，他已经迫不及待了，从小到大被楚云天压制的他，从未有过一天对于修炼的热情如此之高，对于未来是如此的有希望。
他以前是没有机会，而现在，老天将机会放在了他的面前，他绝对不会让它从手中溜走。
决定之后，楚云凡再度闭上了眼睛，开始冲击起了肉身境第六重，所有的真气都涌入了骨骼与骨骼之间，淬炼其中的筋膜。
而一切也正如楚云凡所想的那般，顺理成章，一切都掌握在他的手中，所有修炼筋膜的要点统统都浮现在了他的脑海之中，甚至还有很多之前老师上课时候所讲的修炼方法，原本他的记忆有些模糊了，而现在居然全部都记起来了，甚至连老师说话的时候脸上的表情都记得一清二楚，这种感觉是前所未有的。
这就是传说中的过目不忘的能力！
肉身境第六重筋骨齐鸣的境界在他的面前，根本没有了什么秘密，老师所传授的是人类无数武学大师亲身经历和总结，早就已将一切都阐述的透明无比了，只是当时他的资质有限无法完全理解而已，而现在，都成了他突破到筋骨齐鸣的资粮了。
几乎没有什么障碍，真气在他的体内不断的涌动，一次次的淬炼着肉身，也在不断冲击着肉身境第六重的屏障。
“轰！”
楚云凡的脑海中，像是有什么炸裂开了一样，原本一直牢牢卡住他，不让他前进的第六重的屏障也像是被洪水冲开的水坝一样，被冲击的消失无踪。
此时楚云凡睁开了眼睛，他稍微一动，顿时就是一阵噼里啪啦的声音，好似放鞭炮一样，这就是跨入了肉身境第六重的筋骨齐鸣的明证。

全身的真气在飞速的运转，又一次达到了全新的境界！
这种感觉实在是太舒服了！
只是他感觉，体内那一股清凉的感觉没了，好像是原本一股能量，经过接连不断的修复楚云凡的身体，消散的七七八八了。
这一股能量补充了他修炼突破所需要的能量，习武之人饭量都很大，就是为了补充能量，他们所需要的能量远远比一般人要大。

content_en:
In the situation of tearing and refreshing at the same time, Chu Yunfan could be said to be on the verge of death, but he still gritted his teeth and continued to persevere.
He wanted to cultivate the inner strength of the fifth level of the physical body to the peak. As the name suggests, inner strength is the strength of the internal organs. You can imagine how painful it was for his internal organs to be violently torn, repaired, torn again, and restored again.
Finally, when he opened his eyes again, it was already two hours later!
"I have finally reached the peak of inner strength. I have completed the tempering of my internal organs. I really can't imagine that such a speed will appear in my body. If you only know that I just broke through to inner strength a month ago, I thought it would take several months to break through to the peak of inner strength!" Chu Yunfan thought to himself. At this time, his thinking was clear, and he suddenly thought of many things.
His cultivation speed is so fast, not only because of the power of the "Eternal Emperor's Ultimate Skill", but more importantly, his body seems to have undergone a considerable degree of transformation. Otherwise, no matter how fast the speed is, it is impossible for his cultivation in just a few hours to exceed his previous six years of cultivation.
It was that group of light that could not be seen clearly at that time, which tore and reorganized his countless cells, tore and reorganized again. At that time, his physical body had been transformed, but it is now reflected when he practices the "Eternal Emperor's Ultimate Skill".
There is also that clear flow, I don’t know where it comes from. Key does not have this clear flow to relieve pain. He may stop many times just because of the pain. It is impossible for him to practice so smoothly!
"What exactly entered my body?" Chu Yunfan couldn't help but become a little confused, "Ignore it for now. All in all, this is a good thing for me. As long as I reach the eighth level of the physical realm and look inside, I will know what it is!"
The eighth level of physical realm cultivation is inner vision. As the name suggests, you can see what is going on in your body, such as blood vessels, internal organs, muscles, etc. However, this view is not based on eyesight, but after controlling the physical body to the extreme, everything can be perceived, and many details of the body emerge in the mind, thus creating an effect similar to seeing.
"Now that I have reached the peak of inner strength, I will continue my efforts tonight and directly hit the sixth level of muscle and bone!"
Chu Yunfan temporarily decided to put aside the doubts in his heart and break through the important thing first. He couldn't wait. He had been suppressed by Chu Yuntian since he was a child. There had never been a day when his enthusiasm for cultivation was so high and he was so hopeful for the future.
He had no chance before, but now, God has put the opportunity in front of him, and he will never let it slip away from his hands.
After making the decision, Chu Yunfan closed his eyes again and began to attack the sixth level of the physical realm. All the true energy poured into the spaces between the bones, tempering the fascia in them.
And everything was just as Chu Yunfan thought. Everything was in his hands. All the key points of cultivating fascia appeared in his mind, and there were even many cultivation methods that the teacher had taught before in class. His memory was a little blurry at first, but now he remembered them all. He even remembered the expression on the teacher's face clearly when he spoke. This feeling was unprecedented.
This is the legendary ability of photographic memory!
There were no secrets in front of him at the sixth level of the physical realm, where the muscles and bones were in full swing. What the teacher taught was the personal experience and summary of countless human martial arts masters. Everything had already been explained in an extremely transparent manner. It was just that he had limited qualifications at the time and could not fully understand it. But now, it has become the material for him to break through to the point where the muscles and bones are in full swing.
There were almost no obstacles, and the true energy continued to surge in his body, time and time again.The body is tempered, and it is also constantly impacting the sixth barrier of the physical realm.
"Boom!"
In Chu Yunfan's mind, it was as if something exploded. The sixth barrier that had been firmly blocking him and preventing him from moving forward was like a dam washed away by floods, and disappeared without a trace.
At this time, Chu Yunfan opened his eyes. When he moved slightly, there was a crackling sound, like setting off firecrackers. This was a clear proof that the muscles and bones were singing together as he entered the sixth level of the physical realm.
The zhenqi in the whole body is circulating rapidly, reaching a new level again!
This feeling is so comfortable!
But he felt that the cool feeling in his body was gone, as if the original energy had dissipated after successive repairs to Chu Yunfan's body.
This energy replenished the energy he needed for breakthroughs in cultivation. People who practice martial arts eat a lot. Just to replenish energy, they need far more energy than ordinary people.
